scope: Bounded public metadata survey plus fixed-commit source/doc excerpt review; no upstream software executed, no comparative efficacy benchmark.
activity_rule: recent = default-branch head within 90 days of snapshot and not archived; push time alone does not prove substantive maintenance
source_hash_policy: SHA-256 of decoded UTF-8 text with CRLF normalized to LF by the GitHub CLI subprocess; commit SHA and fixed blob URL preserve repository identity. Not a claim of raw transport-byte hashing.
